evidence.Workflow / Use Case: Portfolio analysis and trading through major AI chatbots
evidence.Claim / Evidence Summary: Scalable Capital opened client portfolio analysis and trading access through major AI chatbots including ChatGPT and Claude, extending regulated brokerage workflows beyond its own app and website.
evidence.Baseline / Comparator: Existing Scalable app and website access
evidence.Likely Value Capturer: Scalable Capital; participating AI platforms; brokerage customers
evidence.Constraint / Bottleneck: Security; authentication; model reliability; customer adoption; regulated-investment safeguards
evidence.Source Type: Company deployment via independent news report
evidence.Source Title: German broker Scalable opens investment platform to major AI chatbots
evidence.Supporting Excerpt (≤20 words): clients can now use major artificial intelligence chatbots such as ChatGPT and Claude to conduct trades and analyze their investment portfolios
evidence.Notes: Live customer-facing brokerage deployment. Improved investment returns remain an unvalidated management expectation, not an outcome.
